obligation_candidates.canon_label: Explicitly state that workspace-tab selection, panel docking, and per-project layout restore are shell-state concerns layered underneath canonical routing.
exact_tokens: Explicitly state that workspace-tab selection, panel docking, and per-project layout restore are shell-state concerns layered underneath canonical routing.
notes: FinalGUISpec.md and storage-plan.md own the shell/workspace state model. Route model should only carry destination intent (what object, which broad surface, which project/run/thread context). Shell state (panel docking, workspace tab, per-project layout) is a separate concern.
cmd.panel.switch and similar commands are shell commands — they must not accumulate canonical object identity.
